faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common Questions

items.question: What is the Shugaosha Way?
items.answer: The Shugaosha Way is a gentle, hands-on facial rebalancing technique that focuses on restoring natural balance, harmony and overall wellbeing.

items.question: How is the Shugaosha Way different from a facial massage?
items.answer: The Shugaosha Way focuses on releasing facial tension and addressing areas of imbalance. As facial balance is restored, the face appears more harmonious, naturally refreshed and balanced.

items.question: Is the Shugaosha Way a regular facial treatment?
items.answer: No. It does not involve skincare products, machines or facial equipment. However, many clients notice their skin appears brighter, firmer and more radiant after treatment.

items.question: Is the treatment painful?
items.answer: The treatment is generally gentle and comfortable. Areas with more tension or imbalance may feel slightly more sensitive during the session, but this usually eases as the treatment progresses.

items.question: How many sessions do I need?
items.answer: Most clients benefit from a series of 4–5 treatments. For the best results, sessions are ideally spaced 3–7 days apart, depending on your individual needs. Each session builds on the previous one, helping your face gradually establish better balance and longer-lasting results.

items.question: How long do the results last?
items.answer: Results vary from person to person. Like any form of self-care, regular maintenance treatments help support and maintain your results over time.

items.question: Is there any downtime?
items.answer: No. There is no downtime. Many clients choose to book their treatment before a special occasion or event to look refreshed and naturally lifted.

items.question: Can I have treatment after Botox or fillers?
items.answer: Yes, but we recommend waiting until Botox or fillers have fully settled. Please let us know before booking so we can advise the most suitable timing.

items.question: Who is not suitable for treatment?
items.answer: Treatment may not be suitable if you are pregnant, have certain medical conditions, or have recently undergone cosmetic procedures. Please let us know before booking so we can advise whether the treatment is suitable for you.

items.question: How long is each appointment?
items.answer: Approximately 45–60 minutes. Each treatment is tailored to your individual needs. We believe more time is not always better. Every session is carefully tailored to suit your face, allowing your tissues and muscles to respond naturally without unnecessary stress.

items.question: How do I book an appointment?
items.answer: Simply contact us via WhatsApp or submit an enquiry through our website.

treatment.introTitle: How Does The Shugaosha Way Work?
treatment.introDesc1: The Shugaosha Way is based on the belief that facial appearance is closely connected to balance, harmony and overall wellbeing.
treatment.introDesc2: Through our signature hands-on approach, we work with the body’s natural structure rather than forcing change.
treatment.introDesc3: Every treatment is personalised, respecting each client’s unique facial features while encouraging a naturally refreshed, balanced and lifted appearance.
treatment.introDesc4: Our goal is not to change who you are, but to help you look and feel your natural best.
treatment.skullDesc1: As we age, daily habits, posture and muscle tension can gradually influence facial balance and overall appearance.
treatment.skullDesc2: The Shugaosha Way focuses on understanding these changes and working with the body’s natural structure through a gentle hands-on approach.
treatment.skullDesc3: Rather than forcing change, our goal is to encourage better balance, harmony and a naturally refreshed appearance.
treatment.techniqueDesc1: The Shugaosha Way is performed using a carefully developed layer-by-layer hands-on approach.
treatment.techniqueDesc2: Rather than focusing on a single feature, we consider how different areas of the face work together to support overall balance and harmony.
treatment.techniqueDesc3: Every treatment is individually tailored to complement your unique facial structure and natural features, helping you achieve results that look balanced, refreshed and naturally you.
